description: `templates`: fallback 'new quiz' notifications (part 7.c), used when the AI text for a language fails its checks. Rotate by IST day number. {category} is filled from `categories` in the same language. Limits after filling: title <= 40 characters, body <= 120; hi must be Devanagari, hi-Latn must have none; no URLs and no answers. `new_questions`: the evening "new questions added" push, rotated by IST day number, same limits.
